subject: general
question:
Six persons, L, M, N, O, P and Q, have cooking classes in different months of the same year, viz. February, March, June, August, September and December

P has the class immediately before Q. Only M has the class before O. L has the class immediately after N and before Q. Which of the following is correct?

options.text: Q has the class in February.
M has the class in March.
P has the class in September.
L has the class in June.

solution:
Given: Six persons, L, M, N, O, P and Q, have cooking classes in different months of the same year, viz. February, March, June, August, September and December.

1) P has the class immediately before Q.

2) Only M has the class before O.

3) L has the class immediately after N and before Q.

Check all the options:

Option (1): Q has the class in February → False

Option (2): M has the class in March → False

Option (3): P has the class in September → True

Option (4): L has the class in June → False

So, P's class is in **September**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
